name: windows-v150-unified-search-pureref-video-bookmarks-and-universal-parser
title: Windows Parity Handoff (v1.5.0): Unified Seamless Search, Bidirectional PureRef (.pur), YouTube/Bilibili Video Bookmarks & Summaries, Universal Web Parser, and Batch Link Media Extraction
description: Bring macOS & iOS v1.5.0 capabilities and cross-platform sync schema parity to Windows (Rust charkle-core + Tauri + React UI): (1) Unified seamless search fusing instant literal/FTS/OCR filtering with background hybrid semantic search (removing standalone semantic toggle buttons and return banners); (2) Bidirectional PureRef (.pur) v1.10 import/export plus v2.0+ multi-format extraction, clean single-image clipboard copy, and original-file gallery drag-out; (3) YouTube & Bilibili video bookmarking with zero-download default collection (link metadata, 16:9 cover, duration, Bilibili WBI AI summary/outline, YouTube chapters/caption digest) and explicit on-demand MP4 save into standalone library assets (native progressive MP4 + optional local yt-dlp fallback); (4) 5-layer universal multi-platform webpage parser (HTML meta, full JSON-LD Schema.org, oEmbed auto-discovery, <video>/lazy hero img/readable lead summary, headless WebView2 SPA DOM probe) persisted in AssetRichMetadata.webPage; (5) Multi-select batch link media extraction across YouTube, Bilibili, X, Xiaohongshu, Threads, Bluesky, Pixiv, Instagram, and rich webpages.
creator: CharTyr
notes: Keep Windows edits strictly inside windows/. Maintain exact camelCase JSON compatibility for AssetRichMetadata.socialPost (youtube/bilibili + videoDurationSeconds/videoSummary/videoOutline/videoID/videoCID) and AssetRichMetadata.webPage (WebPageRichMetadata) across /.charkle/ cloud sync. Coordinate with shared GitHub Release v1.5.0: append Charkle_1.5.0_x64-setup.exe and replace only the Windows placeholder section while preserving macOS and iOS release notes verbatim.
